verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents visual diff review on desktop and web, inline diffs in VS Code, and interactive diff viewing in JetBrains. For checks, it documents hooks that run lint before a commit, test execution, automatic GitHub PR code review, and CI review via GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD. One community comment about self-verification reliability concerns output quality, not whether these features exist, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the diff-review and pre-merge check workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of diff inspection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side
The VS Code extension provides inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and conversation history directly in your editor.
Hooks let you run shell commands before or after Claude Code actions, like auto-formatting after every file edit or running lint before a commit.
Get automatic code review on every PR | GitHub Code Review
In CI, you can automate code review and issue triage with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD.
